cards.title: The game in one minute
cards.text: Survive endless waves in a dark square maze. Build your own attacks from modules found in dead-end chests.
cards.why: Everything else in this pack hangs off this. Mark any part that's off.

parts.title: You
parts.text: A 2×2-cell glowing ring in a square labyrinth. You only see what's in your line of sight.

parts.title: Waves
parts.text: Enemies pour in from the dark, more every minute, like Vampire Survivors. Kills drop XP.

parts.title: Chests
parts.text: Dead ends hold chests. Each has one module: a part that changes an attack (Bounce, Burn, Split…). The deeper the dead end, the better the chest.

parts.title: Level-ups
parts.text: Each level-up shows 4 upgrades for modules you already have (Bounce 2 → 3 bounces). Pick one. Chests give new effects; XP makes them stronger.

parts.title: Three casts
parts.text: Weapon, Summon and Dash. Each is a shape with module slots, and any module works in any of them. That's the build.

parts.title: The exit
parts.text: An exit opens at 10:00. Leave to bank your shards, or stay longer for more until you die.

parts.title: Between runs
parts.text: Shards buy more slots, more modules in the chests, new shapes, and a practice room for building big spells.

cards.title: What this pack is
cards.text: Design only. Nothing is built yet. Every call in here is my pick until you answer it.
cards.why: Start with Look and Spell system: they decide the most. Statuses, enemies and the maze can wait if you're short on time.
cards.details:
The full design is in docs/DESIGN.md in the new Spellmaze folder.

It borrows the building blocks and rules from your maze roguelike design doc (the projectile/line/zone/entity atoms, what children inherit, Piercing and Bouncy, the stacking maths) and cuts them down to what a phone survivor game can show.

Your Wings spell, the Lightning arena and the 21 pressure tests are mapped against it in the Spell system topic.

cards.title: Start building?
cards.text: Once the Look and Spell system answers are in, start stage 1?
cards.why: Stage 1 is the maze, line of sight, the three sticks, the Bolt and the Mite, playable on your phone. Stage 2 adds the Ball, the Dash and five modules on all three, which proves the system. Nothing past that until you've played it.
cards.pick: Yes: stage 1 as soon as Look and Spell system are answered, then stage 2.
cards.details:
Build order:
1. Maze, line of sight, movement, the three sticks, Bolt, Mite. Feel on the phone.
2. Ball and Dash, five modules (Bounce, Burn, Extra, Explode, Home) on all three casts.
3. Chests, level-ups, rarity, the build screen.
4. All enemies, statuses, waves, the exit, the first boss.
5. The rest of the modules, Runes, between-run unlocks, the practice room.

Same setup as Delve: an offline web app on GitHub Pages, landscape, added to the home screen.
